He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova Wildcats]], winning a national championship in 2018. Spellman was drafted 30th overall by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] in the [[2018 NBA draft]]. ==Early life== [[File:Omari Spellman.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Spellman at the 2016 Jordan Brand Classic]] Spellman was born in [[Cleveland, Ohio]]. Spellman began 9th grade at [[Middletown High School (New York)|Middletown High School]] in New York but transferred to [[Hoosac School]] after two to three months, but had to start in 8th grade there.{{cite news|last1=Tydings|first1=Stephen|title=Jay Wright on Omari Spellman ruling: 'I'm argued out'|url=http://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/ncaa/villanova-basketball-jay-wright-omari-spellman-argued-out|access-date=March 31, 2018|work=[[NBC Sports]]|date=September 23, 2016}} Spellman later attended [[North Royalton High School]] in [[North Royalton, Ohio]]. As a sophomore, he averaged 22 points per game and 9.8 rebounds a game for the Bears. Before the start of his Junior year, Spellman decided to attend the [[MacDuffie School]] in [[Granby, Massachusetts]]. Spellman played his senior season at [[St. Thomas More School (Connecticut)|St. Thomas More]] in [[Montville, Connecticut]]. As a senior in 2015–16, he averaged 16 points and seven rebounds per game. Despite not being named a [[McDonald's All-American]], Spellman was selected to play in the 2016 [[Jordan Brand Classic]] where He had a double-double of 12 points and 15 rebounds.{{citation needed|date=December 2023}} Spellman was rated as a five-star recruit and considered a top-15 player of the 2016 high school class.{{Cite web|url=https://n.rivals.com/content/prospects/2016/omari-spellman-509|title=Omari Spellman, 2016 Center – Rivals.com|website=n.rivals.com|access-date=January 7, 2016}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/188078/omari-spellman|title=Omari Spellman – Basketball Recruiting – Player Profiles|website=ESPN.com|access-date=April 1, 2016}} He was ranked the No. 16 overall player in the 2016 ESPN Top 100 and No. 5 among power forwards.{{cite web|title=14 Omari Spellman|url=http://www.villanova.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/omari_spellman_1029432.html|website=[[Villanova Wildcats]]|access-date=March 31, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180625062505/http://www.villanova.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/omari_spellman_1029432.html|archive-date=June 25, 2018|url-status=dead}} He played AAU ball for the PSA Cardinals and wrote poetry as a downtime activity.{{cite news|last1=Borzello|first1=Jeff|title=How Omari Spellman became the perfect final piece in Villanova's Final Four puzzle|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22956033/2018-ncaa-tournament-omari-spellman-final-piece-villanova-wildcats-final-four-return|access-date=March 31, 2018|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 30, 2016}} ==College career== [[File:Villanova Parade 2018 04.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Eric Paschall]], [[Donte DiVincenzo]], Spellman, [[Collin Gillespie]], and [[Jalen Brunson]].]] Spellman was forced to redshirt his freshman year as a partial academic qualifier since he did not graduate with his original high school class. He broke down in tears when this was first announced but was more composed after the appeal process failed. In his redshirt year, he slimmed down from 300 lbs. to 245 lbs and focused on eating healthier. As a redshirt freshman, Spellman shot a team-high 44.6 percent from behind the arc. Spellman had a season-high 27 points in an 87–67 rout of [[Temple Owls men's basketball|Temple]] on December 13.{{cite news|title=Brunson leads No. 1 Villanova in rout of Temple|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400988008|access-date=March 31, 2018|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=December 13, 2017}} He had 18-points, eight rebounds and three blocks in the Sweet 16 matchup against [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]].{{cite news|last1=Serby|first1=Steve|title=Villanova big man knows exactly how to beat Kansas' beast|url=https://nypost.com/2018/03/31/villanova-big-man-knows-exactly-how-to-beat-kansas-beast/|access-date=March 31, 2018|work=[[New York Post]]|date=March 31, 2018}} He earned NCAA All-Region honors for the East region in Boston, alongside teammates [[Eric Paschall]] and [[Jalen Brunson]].{{cite news|last=|first=|title=2018 Men;s College Basketball NCAA Tournament| url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/postseason/men/2018-ncaa.html| access-date=March 17, 2025| work=Sports-Reference.com}} He averaged 10.9 points, 8.0 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game on the national champion Villanova team. Following the season Spellman declared for the [[2018 NBA draft]], and announced he was staying in the draft on May 30.{{cite news|last1=Gallen|first1=Daniel|title=NBA Draft 2018: Villanova's Omari Spellman to remain in draft, forgo three years of eligibility|url=https://www.pennlive.com/sports/index.ssf/2018/05/omari_spellman_nba_draft_villa.html|access-date=June 21, 2018|work=PennLive|date=May 30, 2018}} ==Professional career== ===Atlanta Hawks (2018–2019)=== On June 21, 2018, Spellman was selected by the [[Atlanta Hawks]] with the 30th overall pick in the [[2018 NBA draft]]. He was the third of four Villanova players drafted that year, as well as the last of their first round selections there.{{cite news|last1=Kasinitz|first1=Aaron|title=NBA Draft 2018: Hawks take Villanova forward Omari Spellman with 30th pick|url=https://www.pennlive.com/sports/index.ssf/2018/06/nba_draft_2018_omari_spellman.html|access-date=June 26, 2018|work=[[The Patriot-News]]|date=June 22, 2018}} Spellman signed with the Hawks on July 1, 2018.{{cite web|title=Hawks Sign Kevin Huerter, Omari Spellman And Trae Young|url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/hawks-sign-kevin-huerter-omari-spellman-and-trae-young|website=NBA.com |access-date=July 2, 2018}} On December 30, 2018, Spellman was assigned to the Hawks’ [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[College Park Skyhawks|Erie BayHawks]]. He made his G League debut the next night, scoring 28 points and collecting 14 rebounds in a loss.{{cite web|title=Hawks' Omari Spellman: Assigned to G-League|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/hawks-omari-spellman-assigned-to-g-league/|website=CBSSports.com|date=December 30, 2018|access-date=January 1, 2019}}{{cite
